reusable_pieces.name: typedkey: cache keys with argument types

reusable_pieces.name: _HashedTuple: tuple keys with a stored hash
reusable_pieces.description: Stores a tuple hash after its first successful computation, preserves the subclass during addition and omits stored state through __getstate__.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: The supplied file context shows hashkey and typedkey constructing this class, and _kwmark using the class as a sentinel. __hash__ returns the stored value when present; otherwise it computes tuple.__hash__ and writes instance state. Addition constructs another _HashedTuple, and __getstate__ returns an empty dictionary. No explicit element validation is present. Preserve these semantics and supplied license notices when extracting it.
limitations: Requires hashable elements whose hash and equality behavior remain suitable for cache keys.
The first hash mutates instance state; concurrency and serialization behavior have not been verified here.
It is a private supporting class; integration must supply and review its consumers.

reusable_pieces.name: LRUCache: size-bounded least recently used mapping
reusable_pieces.description: Tracks access and insertion order with OrderedDict and evicts the least recently used entry through its Cache base.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: Supplied file context includes Cache, _DefaultSize and collections imports. Extract with the relevant base implementation: it validates nonnegative maxsize and value sizes, rejects oversized values, and evicts through self.popitem() before storing. LRUCache touches reads only when the key remains present, accounting for __missing__ overrides. Writes update recency; deletion and clear update both storage and order. Empty popitem raises KeyError. Default method arguments bind Cache methods at class definition, so extraction order matters. Retain supplied license notices.
limitations: Cache and _DefaultSize are required supporting definitions; the declaration alone is insufficient.
No locking is visible in these mapping methods; concurrent-use assumptions remain unresolved.
Custom sizing is evaluated on assignment; later mutation of stored values is not remeasured by the shown code.

reusable_pieces.name: FIFOCache: size-bounded insertion-order mapping
reusable_pieces.description: Maintains an OrderedDict alongside Cache storage and removes the first ordered entry when eviction is requested.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: Supplied file context defines Cache and _DefaultSize and imports collections. Cache validates maxsize and assigned value sizes, rejects oversized values, and calls the subclass's popitem while making room. FIFOCache updates order only after base assignment succeeds; overwriting an existing key moves it to the end. Deletion and clear mutate both structures. Empty popitem raises KeyError. Preserve the base's pop behavior and class-definition-time bindings to Cache methods. Retain supplied license notices.
limitations: Overwriting an existing key changes its eviction position; consumers must account for this behavior.
Extraction requires Cache and _DefaultSize, not just this subclass.
No locking is visible; indexed FIFO tests have no supplied bodies.

reusable_pieces.name: _locked: memoization with locked mapping access
reusable_pieces.description: Locks cache lookup, insertion and clearing while computing misses outside the lock; setdefault prefers an entry stored during computation.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: No same_file_reference is supplied: surrounding helpers, imports, constants and wrapper setup may be absent. Review mapping and lock contracts and surrounding decorator integration before extraction; preserve supplied license notices.

reusable_pieces.name: LRUCache
reusable_pieces.description: Size-bounded mapping that tracks recency on stored-key reads and writes, then evicts the least recently used entry.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: Extract with the observed Cache base, _DefaultSize helper, and collections.OrderedDict usage. Cache rejects negative maxsize, negative value sizes, and oversized values; insertion may evict entries before storing. LRUCache.__getitem__ returns the base result and touches only keys actually stored, accommodating __missing__ overrides. __touch updates ordering; deletion and clear update both storage and ordering. Empty popitem raises KeyError. Preserve these interactions when adapting the class.
limitations: Custom getsizeof behavior and subclass __missing__ assumptions need review for the destination.
The supplied test excerpt concerns Cache and depends on an unsupplied CacheTestMixin; it does not establish LRU correctness.
The supplied MIT notice requires retaining copyright and permission notices in copies or substantial portions.

reusable_pieces.name: FIFOCache
reusable_pieces.description: Size-bounded mapping with insertion-order eviction. Replacing an existing entry moves it to the end of the eviction order.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: Extract with the observed Cache base, _DefaultSize helper, and collections.OrderedDict usage. Base initialization rejects negative maxsize; writes reject negative or oversized value sizes and may evict entries. FIFOCache updates ordering only after the base write returns. Reads do not update its ordering, while replacement writes move an existing key to the end. popitem removes the first ordered key through Cache.pop and raises KeyError when empty. Deletion and clear synchronize ordering with base storage.
limitations: Replacement writes renew ordering, which must match the destination's intended FIFO policy.
Size accounting depends on Cache and the supplied getsizeof callback; the declaration is not a standalone mapping implementation.
The supplied MIT notice requires retaining copyright and permission notices in copies or substantial portions.

reusable_pieces.name: hashkey
reusable_pieces.description: Builds tuple-based cache keys from positional arguments and sorted keyword pairs, with a separator and cached tuple hashing.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: The supplied keys.py context defines both supporting pieces: _HashedTuple and _kwmark. Preserve the sentinel separating positional arguments from keywords. With no keywords, hashkey returns _HashedTuple(args) directly; otherwise it appends the sentinel and sorted keyword pairs. _HashedTuple stores its hash on first hashing and returns the same tuple subclass on concatenation. Key construction does not validate hashability; failure can occur when the resulting key is hashed.
limitations: Arguments and keyword values must support hashing when the key is used in a hash-based mapping.
This policy does not append argument types; equal values of different types can share keys.
Indexed key tests have no supplied test content. Retain the supplied MIT copyright and permission notices when applicable.

reusable_pieces.description: Builds cache keys that include the types of positional arguments and keyword values, distinguishing otherwise equal values with different immediate types.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: Extract with the observed _HashedTuple and _kwmark definitions from keys.py. Both branches append positional-argument types before returning. _HashedTuple.__add__ preserves the subclass while these portions are assembled; its hash is cached on first use. No explicit argument validation occurs. This is a distinct key policy from hashkey, rather than a separate memoization implementation.
limitations: Type information covers immediate argument values, not recursively nested contents.
Included values must be hashable when the resulting key is hashed; construction alone does not establish that.

reusable_pieces.name: Scheduler job orchestration
reusable_pieces.description: Maintains jobs, runs due jobs in sorted order, supports forced execution and tag filtering, removes cancelled jobs, and reports the next run and idle time. Pending execution intentionally does not replay missed runs.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: Retain the observed internal helpers _run_job and get_next_run and the next_run property. _run_job recognizes both CancelJob instances and the class itself. get_next_run returns None for empty collections or empty tag results; idle_seconds also returns None without a next run. clear mutates the existing list; cancel_job catches ValueError. run_all iterates a list copy and sleeps after each job. Integrate with the missing Job implementation, including should_run, run, tags and ordering; the supplied Job.__lt__ compares next_run. Resolve logger, time, datetime and annotation bindings rather than assuming every indexed import is required.
